items.quote: The next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him,’ but she had hidden him.
items.contrast: The other woman, addressed as “her,” hid the son; the woman speaking to the king did not.
items.reason: The speaker distinguishes herself (“I”) from the woman she addressed (“her”), then says that “she” had hidden her son. Resolving these pronouns identifies the other woman as the actor.
